title: Meridian Mutual Group to launch mileage-based motor cover on 3 November

children.text: Lyon, 20 October 2026. Meridian Mutual Group will launch Motor Flex 2027 in France, Germany and Italy on 3 November. The comprehensive policy adjusts the premium every quarter to the mileage declared by the member.

The product responds to a shift in driving habits: 41% of the group's motor members now drive under 8,000 km a year. Motor Flex 2027 is expected to reduce their premium by 15 to 25% compared with a standard comprehensive policy.
Contact: press@meridian-demo.test

title: Meridian Mutual Group reports half-year 2026 results

children.text: Lyon, 2 September 2026. Meridian Mutual Group today reported results for the first half of 2026. Membership reached 2.1 million (+3.4%), gross written premiums EUR 1.84 billion (+2.9%), and the solvency ratio 212%.
Average claims settlement time fell to nine days from twelve. The group invested EUR 38 million in its claims platform and hired 60 claims handlers.
As a mutual, the group pays no dividend. The surplus is allocated to reserves and to the 2027 premium review, which will be announced in November.
Contact: press@meridian-demo.test

title: Meridian Mutual Group opens twenty agencies in southern Italy

children.text: Lyon, 16 June 2026. The group will open twenty agencies in Naples, Bari and Palermo by December 2026, its first expansion in southern Italy since entering the market in 2006.
All agents are employees, trained on the full product range.
Contact: press@meridian-demo.test

title: Two member representatives elected to the board

children.text: Lyon, 28 May 2026. The general meeting elected Rosa Caputo, an agent in Bari, and Henri Delmas, a retired teacher from Lille, as member representatives on the board for a four-year term.
Member representatives hold four of the twelve board seats.
Contact: press@meridian-demo.test

title: Meridian Mutual Group appoints Chiara Benedetti as Country Manager for Italy

children.text: Lyon, 19 May 2026. Meridian Mutual Group has appointed Chiara Benedetti as Country Manager for Italy, effective 1 June. She succeeds Marco Ferraro, who retires after 14 years in the role.
Chiara Benedetti joined the group in 2012 and most recently led the Italian claims organisation, where she oversaw the migration to the group claims platform.
Contact: press@meridian-demo.test

title: Meridian Mutual Group selects a single content platform for its three markets

children.text: Lyon, 24 March 2026. Meridian Mutual Group will migrate the websites of its French, German and Italian operations to a single content platform by August 2026.
The platform will let headquarters publish product information once and each country adapt it under a shared compliance approval, replacing three separate systems.
Contact: press@meridian-demo.test

title: Meridian Mutual Group reports full-year 2025 results

children.text: Lyon, 3 March 2026. Gross written premiums reached EUR 3.6 billion in 2025 (+3.1%). The combined ratio improved to 94.2%. Membership stood at 2.03 million at year end.
As a mutual, the group pays no dividend. EUR 120 million of the surplus is allocated to the new climate reserve.
Contact: press@meridian-demo.test

title: Meridian Mutual Group sets aside EUR 120 million climate reserve

children.text: Lyon, 27 January 2026. The board of Meridian Mutual Group has approved a dedicated reserve of EUR 120 million to absorb the cost of major climate events without passing it on to members in the following year.
The reserve will be drawn on when weather-related claims in a single year exceed 130% of the ten-year average.
Contact: press@meridian-demo.test
